scenes.big: Stop form spam without a CAPTCHA
scenes.say: Here's how to stop most form spam without an annoying captcha.

scenes.title: The honeypot field
scenes.say: Add a hidden field that real visitors never see. Many simple bots fill in every field they find.
scenes.caption: A hidden field humans never see

scenes.title: In n8n
scenes.code:
const trap = body.website;
if (trap) return reject('spam');
scenes.say: In n8n, if that field has anything in it, reject the submission before it costs you an AI call.
scenes.caption: Filled in? Reject before any AI call

post.caption:
Honeypot trick: add a hidden 'website' field to the form. Humans never see it; many simple bots fill every field. If it's filled, reject the submission in n8n before spending an AI call.

Not perfect, but it stops a lot of junk.
